info.name: ASSA Middleware - Local Desktop (localhost:6031)
info.description:
Koleksi Postman resmi untuk pengujian seluruh API ASSA Middleware WSO2 MI Monorepo & Gateway.
Target Endpoint Default: http://localhost:6031
Pre-configured untuk Local Desktop (localhost:6031).

Cakupan Layanan (Semua 7 Microservice):
- 1. Health & Readiness Probes (16 Endpoint: General & Seluruh 7 Microservice)
- 2. Auth & Scope Security Guards (15 Skenario: 401 Unauthorized & 403 Forbidden cross-services)
- 3. Parameter & Input Validation (14 Skenario: 400 Bad Request validasi bisnis)
- 4. Inquiry, Search & Pagination (22 Skenario: 200 OK dengan filter filterBy, plat_no, CustomerCode/CustomerName, & metadata pagination)
- 5. Transactional & Fan-Out Endpoints (12 Skenario: Service Request Fan-out 10x Retries, Barantum Public Gateway nested unit, Vendor Create V2 XML FTP, SPK Due List V2 dengan Invoice/Pajak, Payments Service Create & Idempotency Replay)
- 6. Background Retry Worker (2 Skenario: GET & POST Trigger)

Total Skenario: 81 requests.
